sourceFile: 6 BRS-161014 Report TEST new BP+SM ASS'Y GUIDE JIG improve 2023.08.18_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the jig-improvement validation but groups result row numbers/dates as changed conditions and implies an unsupported baseline comparison.
issues: Changed factor is misgrouped as baseline vs 1,2; 1 and 2 are result sequence numbers.
Baseline/normal condition is not citeably measured in shown rows.
Outcome rows 12-13 are two test dates under the new jig, not separate test conditions.
Report!26 is cited but not provided in context, so NG-reason outcome cannot be verified here.
Decision row is listed but its content is not captured.
requiredUserQuestions: Should this be treated as a single-arm new version (2) guide jig validation with no baseline?
Can the full NG-reason and decision rows be provided for citation?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to new version (2) BP/SM assembly guide jig improvement.
Set baseline as implicit previous jig only if documented; otherwise mark no explicit baseline.
Use dates 2023-08-18 and 2023-08-19 as subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
Keep Result check as the main outcome with input, OK, NG, and NG rate from rows 11-13.
Remove or verify the Report!26 NG-reason outcome using full row context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Rows 2,5-8,11-13 support title, purpose, changed condition, and results; cited Report!26 and decision evidence are insufficiently shown.
